cases.title: Select Available Seat and Calculate Price
cases.description: Preconditions: Webpage is loaded. Action: Click an available seat without the occupied class. Expected behavior: Seat is marked as selected, selected seat count in data-testid='selected-count' updates, and total price in data-testid='total-price' updates correctly.

cases.title: Attempt to Select Occupied Seat
cases.description: Preconditions: Webpage is loaded. Action: Click a seat marked as occupied. Expected behavior: Occupied seat is not selectable and does not affect the selected count or total price.

cases.title: Toggle Seat Selection and Store in LocalStorage
cases.description: Preconditions: Webpage is loaded. Action: Click an available seat like data-testid='seat-1-1' to toggle selection. Expected behavior: Seat selection status is toggled, visually marked, stored in localStorage, and counts/prices update dynamically.

cases.title: Deselect Previously Selected Seat
cases.description: Preconditions: A seat is already selected. Action: Click the selected seat again to deselect it. Expected behavior: Seat loses selection status, UI updates, and localStorage updates accordingly.

cases.title: Restore State from LocalStorage
cases.description: Preconditions: Local storage contains 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex'. Action: Load the webpage. Expected behavior: Corresponding seats are marked with the 'selected' class and movie dropdown sets to the stored movie index.

cases.title: Default State when LocalStorage is Empty
cases.description: Preconditions: Local storage does not contain 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex'. Action: Load the webpage. Expected behavior: No seats are marked as selected and the dropdown defaults to the first movie option 'The Big Lebowski ($10)'.

cases.title: Dynamic Price Update Upon Changing Movie Selection
cases.description: Preconditions: Seats are already selected and a movie is chosen. Action: Change the movie selection from the dropdown with data-testid 'movie-select'. Expected behavior: Total price updates based on the new ticket price while maintaining the count of selected seats.

cases.title: Interact with Seats Using Legend Statuses
cases.description: Preconditions: Movie Seat Booking page is loaded with legends visible. Action: Click available seats and attempt to click occupied seats. Expected behavior: Available seats toggle selection and update totals, while occupied seats remain non-interactive and unselectable.

analysis.analysis: For e2edev_bench_03-R-1, e2edev_bench_03-R-2, e2edev_bench_03-R-4, and e2edev_bench_03-R-5: Normal scenario: Preconditions - Webpage is loaded with default movie selected. Action - Click an available seat (e.g., data-testid='seat-1-1'). Expected behavior - Seat is marked as selected, data-testid='selected-count' updates to 1, and data-testid='total-price' updates to match the movie price. Boundary scenario: Action - Click all available seats on the map. Expected behavior - Count and total price scale linearly with the number of available seats. Edge scenario: Action - Click a seat marked as occupied. Expected behavior - Seat state does not change, and selected count and total price remain unaffected. Abnormal scenario: Action - Select a movie from data-testid='movie-select' (e.g., 'Fargo ($12)') after selecting seats. Expected behavior - Total price recalculates using the new movie price while maintaining the selected seat count. Recovery scenario: Action - Click a selected seat again to deselect it. Expected behavior - Seat loses selected status, and count and total price decrease accordingly. For e2edev_bench_03-R-3: Normal scenario: Preconditions - localStorage has valid 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex' keys. Action - Load the webpage. Expected behavior - Corresponding seats are marked with the 'selected' class and movie dropdown reflects the stored movie index. Edge scenario: Preconditions - localStorage is empty. Action - Load the webpage. Expected behavior - No seats are marked as selected and the dropdown defaults to 'The Big Lebowski ($10)'.
